ATEQ is a global provider of Leak/Flow Testing equipment for all industries to ensure the integrity of manufactured components. ATEQ's F620 leak tester provides accurate leak rate readings at a fast cycle time and has a variety of sensor and regulator options to customize the instrument to meet your testing specifications. ATEQ also offers consulting, training, preventative maintenance and in-house or onsite repairs and standard or ISO 17025 calibrations.
